description: Create content and publish it live to connected platforms in one step (writes to external social networks).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key = same post: reuse it when retrying this exact call. Without it, an identical call within 10 minutes is treated as a retry.

platform_options.description: Advanced per-platform settings. workspace_id.description: Team workspace UUID from list_workspaces. Omit for the user's personal accounts.
